integrity: The Gauss-map, dual-degree and cusp claims are supported by the symbolic proof and finite consistency checker. Earlier automorphism and genus results are credited; no independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Valid for prime powers q>2 and even n>=4 over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p, for the displayed Kummer plane model. No description of singularities of its dual plane curve. Genus and maximality established in the motivating primary paper. No independently performed mathematical audit; historical novelty remains provisional.
title: Purely inseparable Gauss maps and exact dual degrees for the even Ma–Wang maximal curves
